title: ononis fruticosa subvar. intermedia
intro: Ononis fruticosa subvar. intermedia, commonly known as a variety of Burn Clover, is a plant species within the legume family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antibacterial agent. The therapeutic actions of Ononis fruticosa subvar. intermedia include its use in treating various conditions like arthritis, wounds, and infections due to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
